text:
mariana: Hey team — quick flag. I moved from NL -> US on 2025-02-12 and my most recent paycheck still shows Netherlands tax withholding. Withheld ~€2,100 for Feb/Mar combined. Can someone check whether my tax country got updated?

jen-payroll: Hi Mariana — sorry about that. Can you confirm the relocation effective date (you did), and whether you uploaded your W-4 + state withholding to Workday? Also need SSN/TIN on file.

mariana: Confirmed relocation 2025-02-12. I uploaded W-4 on 2025-02-15 and updated address to NY in Workday. I didn't see a place to upload SSN there but I entered last 4 in the profile. I attached relocation memo in the thread.

sam-peopleops: Thanks for the heads up @mariana :wave: We'll open a payroll ticket and check mapping from hire-country -> tax-country. Sometimes the payroll system keeps the original country until an admin flips it.

jen-payroll: I see the worker record still has taxCountry=NL in our payroll system. I'll request an override. Ticket created: PR-4321.

payroll-bot: PR-4321 created by jen-payroll. Status: triaged. Priority: high. Next payroll window for retro adjustments: 2025-03-31.

jen-payroll: Quick note on docs we need to resolve and process any retro refund: 1) copy of passport or US visa showing arrival, 2) proof of US address (utility or lease), 3) copy of submitted W-4. Once we flip taxCountry to US we may need to run a retro gross/net adj for Feb payroll.

mariana: I can attach passport page and lease. One question — if NL withheld already, will Redwood file for a refund from NL or will I need to claim on my NL tax return?

adrian-hr: Good Q. Cross-border refunds depend on timing and whether the NL employer-side withholding was statutory. HR & Tax counsel will review. In many cases employer can request an adjustment/refund but it can take months. We'll coordinate with local payroll vendor in NL.

jen-payroll: Operationally we'll: 1) update taxCountry to US and taxState to NY in the payroll record, 2) run a retro payroll correction to remove NL taxes and withhold US taxes going forward, 3) if NL taxes were collected, open a refund request with NL vendor. If refund isn't possible employer-side, we document amounts so you can claim a foreign tax credit on your US return.

jen-payroll: Example of the internal change I'll make (Workday API):
```
PUT /api/workers/67890/tax
{
  "taxCountry": "US",
  "taxState": "NY",
  "w4SubmittedDate": "2025-02-15"
}
```

mariana: Thanks. Also will this change the W-2? I need the right docs for tax filing and to avoid double tax.

jen-payroll: If changes affect YTD withholding we'll issue corrected year-end docs (e.g., W-2c) or provide a payroll statement for your tax prep. For international moves mid-year, sometimes we produce a supplemental statement and coordinate with tax counsel. We'll confirm in ticket PR-4321.

sam-peopleops: We're escalating to benefits/tax counsel for the refund path. Expect an update in 3-5 business days after they review documents.

mariana: Appreciate it — attaching passport and lease now. Please keep me posted; happy to provide anything else. :slightly_smiling_face:

jen-payroll: Got the attachments, thanks. I'll update the record and post the confirmation in PR-4321.

payroll-bot: PR-4321 updated: taxCountry change queued. Owner: jen-payroll. ETA for first update: 2025-03-18.

mariana: Thanks all :heart:
